title: The Stitch Fix Guide To Dressing In Your 40s
summary: Your 40s aren't about dressing a certain way. They're about owning exactly who you are and letting your style say it out loud. Our Stylists share their tips for dressing for the woman you are right now. See what they recommend.
body_markdown:
Personal style is a powerful expression of who you are: a dynamic, confident woman who’s constantly learning, changing and growing (in age and in mind!). And what you choose to wear is a way to express that. Are you bold? Are you sophisticated? Are you sporty one day, and classic the next? Whatever your M.O., your 40s are all about confidently owning who you are, and unapologetically reflecting it in your style.


Equipped with the right toolkit of inspo (plus a few pro tips from our Stitch Fix Stylists), you’ll be well on your way to dressing for where you are right now, will be tomorrow and all through your fabulous 40s.


## Fashion for Women in Their 40s: 5 Style Tips


### 1. Find Your Fit: Why It Matters Most After 40


By the time you hit your 40s, you’re feeling confident and comfortable with who you are. So when it comes to dressing, feeling good is priority number one. Wear not only what makes you look great, but what makes you *feel* great.


The Secret? A flawless fit. “The right fit can make even simple pieces look polished, modern, and intentional — while an ill-fitting garment can distract from an otherwise great outfit. A well-fitting blazer, trouser or dress instantly looks more refined,” says Stitch Fix Stylist Julie.


Seek out pieces that fit beautifully, and when in doubt, splurge on an expert tailor—you deserve it! Clothes always look best when they fit like they were made for you.


### 2. Don’t Be Afraid to Take Style Risks


Whether you’re craving a new color or a complete style overhaul, we’re all for taking risks. Owning your style means exploring, so shake things up to keep your closet feeling fresh and exciting. Try a statement shade in a smaller way first, experiment with new prints, or go monochromatic for an instantly put together look


“Chili red is the perfect way to take a style risk without completely stepping outside your comfort zone. Try it in a handbag, shoe, belt, or statement earring before committing to a full red look,” says Stylist Julie.


Red’s not your color? Swap in whatever shade feels like your version of bold. Stylist Erin says, “Don’t shy away from trends in your 40s — just make them work for you. Choose one or two current trends and pair them with timeless pieces you already love.” When choosing what to wear in your 40s, it’s all about pushing the boundaries of what you think you should wear.


### 3. Find Style Inspiration All Around You


If you find yourself stuck in a style rut, or you’re not feeling quite like yourself in your clothes, look outward for inspiration. People-watch on the streets or at the office, scroll for outfit ideas, or simply pay attention to the world around you.


“Your surroundings can be a great color palette. Notice a beautiful storefront, a flower arrangement, artwork, architecture or even a restaurant interior. Then ask: Could I wear these colors together?” says Stylist Julie.


Your Stylist is another great source of inspiration. Message them directly in Stylist Connect to talk through what’s catching your eye, or simply flag it in your next request. Tell your Stylist you’re ready for a more adventurous Fix, and let them run with it. Then, take your newfound inspo and turn it into a fresh outfit that feels authentically you.


### 4. Confidence Is Your Best Accessory


“Wear pieces that make you feel comfortable, capable and like the best version of yourself. In your 40s, great style is less about following every trend and more about knowing what you love and wearing it with confidence,” says Stylist Jackie. She’s right: There’s nothing more powerful than genuine self-confidence. When you walk into a room, the goal is for people to see you first—your outfit is just the supporting cast.


### 5. Let Your Style Evolve With You


Just like you, your style will continue to evolve. Think of dressing yourself not only as an expression of who you are, your mood and your vibe, but something that can constantly be tweaked and adjusted to fit each new season of your life.


“Style evolution doesn’t mean reinventing your wardrobe. Try a new silhouette, an unexpected color, or a fresh way to wear an old favorite. Stay curious about what feels like you now,” adds Stylist Caro.


## 5 Investment-Worthy Wardrobe Essentials for Women Over 40


### 1. The Modern Blazer


Whether it’s a fluid, unstructured cut or a bold print, choose a blazer that instantly upgrades your outfit. The key is picking a current silhouette rather than a traditional, overly structured style. The key here is keeping the silhouette timeless so you can wear it for years, not just a season.


“Throw it over jeans and a tee, a knit dress, or tailored pants to make a simple outfit feel intentional,” says Stylist Julie.


### 2. Jeans that Work: Straight, Wide-Leg and Bootcut Denim


A[great-fitting pair of jeans](https://www.stitchfix.com/women/jeans) is your style secret weapon—you can pull them out for almost any occasion and know you’ll feel amazing. Stylist Jackie says a great pair of jeans can instantly elevate your wardrobe and “becomes a reliable foundation you can dress up or down, making everyday style feel polished and effortless.”


If you haven’t already found your holy-grail denim, let your Stylist know if you’re hoping to try straight, wide-leg or bootcut fits, as well as new washes and rises.


### 3. Statement Flats: Loafers, Mary Janes or Modern Ballet Flats


You’re finally ready to give your heels a break — and statement flats like loafers, Mary Janes or ballet flats are the perfect trade. Stylist Julie says statement flats “are a smart investment for women in their 40s because they bring together comfort, sophistication and personality without sacrificing style.”Whether your vibe is cropped denim or a casual knit dress, a great pair of flats completes virtually any look..


### 4. An Everyday Bag that Feels Elevated


Your 40s can be *capital-B* busy. Between work, family and everything in between, an effortless bag on hand is key.


“Think of your everyday bag as an outfit completer, not just something that carries your essentials. A polished shoulder bag, East-West silhouette, or structured crossbody can instantly elevate denim and a tee, tailoring, or a dress while still working for your real-life routine,” says Stylist Carolina.


### 5. The Dress that Does it All


[Shake up your dress game](https://www.stitchfix.com/women/blog/style-guide/find-the-perfect-dress) with a silhouette that works as hard as you do. “Investing in a great, versatile dress gives you an effortless go-to for everything from workdays to weekends and special occasions,” says Stylist Jackie.


Don’t know where to start? Stylist Caro has you covered:


“The best versatile dress is one you can imagine wearing at least three different ways. Look for a modern silhouette, like a column, shirt, or midi dress, that can shift from sneakers and a casual layer during the day to statement flats and elevated accessories for dinner.”
